methods.name: Combined training strategy CNN-based semantic segmentation model
methods.summary: A modified U-Net architecture with residual blocks and deep supervision, trained on combined landslide inventories from multiple regions to generalize to unseen events.
methods.verbatim: The weights and network architecture of CNN model trained using the combined learning approach is publicly available at https://github.com/nprksh/landslide-mapping-with-cnn.

data_links.name: Event-landslide inventories for study areas B, C, E, and F

code_links.name: CNN model trained using a combined learning approach for landslide mapping
code_links.summary: A convolutional neural network was trained to map landslides using a combined learning approach, taking a DSM and pre-/post-event Sentinel-2 image pairs as inputs. Model weights, architecture, and a Jupyter Notebook demonstrating the workflow are publicly released.

availability.author_statement: Model with weights and code referenced in Data Availability statement

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory are mentioned to be available at the repository link, and other input datasets are practically accessible via public providers. The custom CNN model code and weights are provided via a persistent GitHub repository link.
